points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake and README are committed; clean rebuild was not repeated because the external symlink is dangling.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Submitted main.cpp exposes solve --case/--output and reports bad invocation.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, physics, output and solver source are separated.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal external-solver invocation found; trust policy excludes internet similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON and CLI paths, rather than two mesh-name branches, are source-supported.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: MPI code exists, but report Table rankcmp shows order-one steady NACA force changes across ranks.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Exceptions and positivity clamps are present; no independent stress rerun was performed.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Attempt contains diagnostics, but final immutable submission omits all raw case packages.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable C++ source, but many tuning scripts and excluded raw outputs limit reproducibility.

disqualification_flags.text: MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
disqualification_flags.evidence: report.tex rank comparison reports NACA M0.15 CL 0.002416 at np=1 versus 53.72 at np=2, while calling the behavior qualitatively consistent.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Report and source describe compressible Navier-Stokes and nondimensional variables.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS unstructured mesh and boundary-family code is present.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face-based residual assembly is source-supported.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Approximate flux implementation is present; no independent numerical verification.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip branches are source-supported.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Gradient/reconstruction exists, but reported M2 laminar production uses first-order mode.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Limiter/positivity paths exist; production reliability is not demonstrated for shock cases.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier viscous treatment and wall output are source-supported.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Diagonal implicit and CFL controls are present, with documented weak convergence.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2/inner-solve path exists; Re200 report contains mutually contradictory periodicity text.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS/halo code is present, but retained rank comparison establishes severe rank dependence.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight raw packages exist only in the immutable attempt worktree, not in the curated submission.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Validator is reproducible for the eight attempt packages after excluding _rerun_logs; curated commit itself has none.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Raw/report evidence shows seven pass and M2 inviscid failed; metadata nonetheless says converged.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M2 failure and order-one MPI inconsistency materially undermine the raw claims.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Committed figures are numerous and readable, including Mach/pressure histories and fields.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: The LaTex report is substantial but contains M2 and Re200 claim contradictions.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: No raw CSV/field/manifest is committed, so figures cannot be traced from the submission.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: CMake/CLI source is credible, but clean rebuild and final contract output are not reproducible from curated commit.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS unstructured geometry, adjacency and boundary tags are source-supported.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative flux/residual and wall branches are implemented, with no independent solver rerun.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Second-order machinery exists, but report documents first-order M2 laminar production fallback.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Viscous gradients, stresses and heat flux are source-supported; final wall evidence is excluded.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Implicit/BDF2 machinery and Re200 inner statistics exist, but report periodicity statements conflict.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS and halo primitives exist, but raw rank comparison establishes order-one steady result dependence.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Attempt raw packages show seven credible passes and failed M2 inviscid; no reproducible final package in submission.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Strong figure coverage and substantial report, reduced for contradictions and missing source-data traceability.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Module split is usable, though tuning scripts and reproducibility exclusions constrain extension.
